title: 14 High-Intent Meetings for a Clinical Research Services Firm
challenge: A clinical research support company struggled to communicate its specialised expertise to pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies. Its outreach often reached general business contacts rather than the teams responsible for research partnerships.
solution: Myntmore refined the firm's positioning and identified relevant stakeholders across clinical operations, research partnerships and outsourcing. We developed outreach sequences around specific research capabilities, supported by founder content on operational challenges and clinical research collaboration.
results: Improved engagement from relevant research decision-makers.
